summary: Confirmed: MDC 'Designated Camping Sites', free, FCFS, no hookups, 14-day limit; area page: 'Camping is permitted on or adjacent to these lots' (the ramp lot and one 500 ft north). MDC still maps no camping points, so the camping IS the lots; pin on the ramp lot is right. Riverfront kept: the lot's west edge is ~10 m from a ~35 m-wide river across riprap.
flags: CAMPING LOCATED: MDC's GIS camping layer still has no point here (queried 3 km round), and the 12/28/2021 map shows only parking lots and the ramp. The area page says: 'Two parking lots are provided. One parking lot is located adjacent to the concrete boat ramp. A parking lot 500 feet north provides additional parking for hunters and other area users. Camping is permitted on or adjacent to these lots.' So the camping places are lot 2897 (the stored pin, 39.85426,-91.67459, ramp lot ~40x45 m gravel) and the next lot north, 808 (39.85709,-91.67411); a third lot (2898, 39.85951,-91.67425) sits near CR 134. A 23-ft rig fits the ramp lot easily; access is gravel CR 134 then MDC's gravel lane - no ford.

INCLUSION note (not a drop call): this is lot camping ('on or adjacent to these lots') under MDC's 'Designated Camping Sites' tag - kept under the 2026-09-29 rule that the MDC tag is the bar; noting it because the wildlife-agency rule excludes ramp-lot allowances elsewhere.

WATERFRONT (stored riverfront): kept. On the 0.12 m/px frame the ramp lot's whole west edge is a ~5-10 m riprap bank straight down to the South Fabius, which measures ~35 m wide there (over the ~30 m riverfront line). Nothing lies between a rig parked on that edge and the water - no road, no other lot - so the lot itself is within a pad-depth; the concrete ramp lane is at the lot's south corner and is not the basis. The north lot (808) is ~120 m from the river through woods - no value from it.
